title: CycloneDX Pre-Defined Perspectives Registry
description: Registry of well-known, pre-defined perspectives. Maps each reserved perspective identity (cdx:perspectives: namespace) to the catalog document that defines it under the repository's perspectives/ directory. This registry is maintained independently of the CycloneDX specification release cycle: entries in the companion data file (perspectives-defs.json) may be added or revised, and new catalog document versions published, without a change to the versioned specification schemas. The specification schema references only preDefinedPerspectivesEnum.

lastUpdated.title: Last Updated
lastUpdated.description: The date and time (timestamp) when the registry data was last updated.

perspectives.title: Pre-Defined Perspectives
perspectives.description: The catalog of pre-defined perspectives. Each entry maps a reserved identity to the catalog document defining it.

predefined.title: Pre-Defined Perspective Identity
predefined.description: The reserved identity of the perspective. Matches the `predefined` field of a perspective in a CycloneDX document.

file.title: Catalog Document
file.description: Path, relative to the repository root, of the catalog document defining this perspective. The document's `version` is the perspective's version, referenced by `predefinedVersion`.

description.title: Description
description.description: A short description of the perspective.

preDefinedPerspectivesEnum.title: Pre-Defined Perspective Identities
preDefinedPerspectivesEnum.description: The reserved identities of well-known, pre-defined perspectives, using the reserved cdx:perspectives: namespace path. Referenced by the specification's perspective schema.
